versions.description_html:
Empower citizen developers with Power Platform through managed environments, DLP, templates, training, support, CoE oversight, ALM, and guardrails.

Most organizations are sitting on untapped innovation potential — and it lives in the people who know their business processes best. Citizen developers, empowered with the Microsoft Power Platform, are turning business knowledge into working apps, automated workflows, and real-time data insights without writing a single line of code. This episode explores why empowering citizen developers with Power Platform is one of the highest-ROI strategies a modern business can pursue.

The numbers make the case: companies that enable citizen development save an average of 1.6 hours per week per employee, reduce IT backlogs by up to 38%, and cut development costs by more than 45%. Power Platform is the engine behind these results — with over 50,000 active makers building 250,000+ apps monthly.

But technology alone isn’t enough. The real success factor is governance. When IT and business units collaborate through a structured citizen development program, you get faster innovation, higher security, and solutions that actually solve the right problems.

This episode breaks down how to build that culture, what tools support it, and how leading organizations have already made the shift — so you can do the same.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

• What citizen developers are and why they’re critical to business agility
• How Microsoft Power Platform enables low-code and no-code app development at scale
• Why citizen developers save time, reduce costs, and reduce IT dependency
• How to build a governance framework that keeps citizen development secure and scalable
• How IT and business teams collaborate most effectively using Power Platform
• Real-world examples of citizen development driving measurable ROI
• Key metrics to track the impact and success of your citizen development program

CORE INSIGHT

Empowering citizen developers isn’t about replacing IT — it’s about multiplying your organization’s ability to innovate. When the people closest to business problems have the tools to solve them, your entire company moves faster. Power Platform is the bridge between business expertise and technical execution, and the organizations that build this bridge systematically are outpacing those that don’t.

WHO THIS IS FOR

• IT managers and Power Platform admins building citizen development programs
• Business leaders seeking to reduce reliance on external developers and IT queues
• Digital transformation teams driving low-code adoption across departments
• Microsoft 365 admins and Power Platform governance leads
• Anyone responsible for innovation, productivity, or workforce enablement

ABOUT THE HOST

This episode is part of M365.FM — the podcast for Microsoft 365 professionals who want to stay ahead of the curve in modern work, AI, security, and productivity. Each episode delivers practical, search-driven insights for IT leaders, data professionals, and enterprise decision-makers navigating the Microsoft ecosystem.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Power Platform Governance Without Killing Innovation: Security, DLP, Environments & Citizen Development with Michael Roth [MVP]
  • Reduce Developer Backlogs with Citizen Automation
  • More Power Platform episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Power Platform: the most-listened episodes
